verdicts.reason: Both use the same weak split. The oversized headline fills the lower left. Body copy, CTA and legal text are squeezed into a narrow right column with ragged centred wrapping ("Every bottle / 25% off from / sunrise to"). The legal line is set almost as large as the offer copy, which flattens the hierarchy, and the CTA is small and buried under the body copy. A also pushes the shrunken bottle against the left edge under the logo, leaving a dead empty centre. B keeps the bottle centred in the radial glow, closer to the original's focal axis. B has a minor flaw of its own: the last legal line ("Co., 2026.") runs into a background dot.
